colors.background: transparent (relies on persistent 3D lobby). Content wrappers should use rgba(26, 46, 60, 0.7) with backdrop-blur-xl.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Frosted glass panels with chamfered clip-path corners. Add class: `[clip-path:polygon(16px_0,100%_0,100%_calc(100%-16px),calc(100%-16px)_100%,0_100%,0_16px)]`.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Scanline/grain overlays using CSS repeating-linear-gradient and noise backgrounds to enhance the R&D lab screen feel.
visual_enhancers.glows: Intense text-shadows and box-shadows mimicking neon lights on interactive elements.

layouts.Lexicon_Graph_View: A full-screen data-visualization container overlaid on the 3D lobby. The graph is centered with a UI overlay (absolute positioned). A category legend floats at the bottom right. A detail pane (for node hover/click) slides in from the left.
layouts.Engagement_Dossier_Page: CSS Grid layout mimicking an exhibition hall display. The 'Plaque' (sticky left column: col-span-1 md:col-span-4) holds the mandate, synopsis, and capability leads. The 'Telemetry' (scrollable right column: col-span-1 md:col-span-8) contains outcome stats, timeline rail, and detailed operational highlights.

grids.dossier_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto p-8 relative z-10

TelemetryStrip.description: Inline moving stats readout using react-fast-marquee. Mimics live R&D lab data telemetry with monospace fonts and neon colors.

ExhibitPlaque.description: Frosted glass card with chamfered clip-path corners, #1a2e3c bg, glowing gradient border. Used as the main container for the case study synopsis.

TimelineRail.description: Vertical timeline component for operational highlights. Features a continuous glowing line with animated dots connecting to log entries.

ConstellationGraph.description: Interactive node-edge constellation map. Renders ~11 nodes and ~33 directed edges. Highlights neighbors on hover.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: -translate-y-1, increase glow blur radius, and brighten border gradient.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions, e.g., `transition-[box-shadow,border-color,transform] duration-300 ease-out`. DO NOT use transition-all.
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect by disabling graph physics (static rendering) and removing marquee animations via CSS media queries.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass panels meets WCAG 4.5:1 ratio by keeping glass background opacity high enough.
accessibility.keyboard: All nodes in the constellation graph and log entries in the timeline must be focusable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns, good for data telemetry texture placeholders
Cyberpunk-ish architectural layout for case study placeholder imagery

3d_libraries_and_steps.reasoning: A 2D force graph with a transparent background ensures the persistent Three.js lobby is visible underneath while keeping the UI snappy and easy to interact with.
steps: 2. Wrap in an ErrorBoundary and Suspense.
4. Render nodes using `nodeCanvasObject` to draw chamfered rectangles or glowing circles with Orbitron labels.
5. Render edges as glowing lines based on the relationship array.
6. Add `onNodeHover` logic to highlight connected neighbors and trigger tooltips.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard .js extensions for React components. DO NOT output .tsx files.
Ensure backgrounds for main containers (like ExhibitPlaque) use semi-transparent colors (e.g. bg-[#1a2e3c]/70 with backdrop-blur-md) to let the persistent 3D lobby show through.
Import fonts in the CSS file: `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=Orbitron:wght@400;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;700&display=swap');`.
Implement the 'clip-path' chamfered corners using Tailwind arbitrary variants: `[clip-path:polygon(16px_0,100%_0,100%_calc(100%-16px),calc(100%-16px)_100%,0_100%,0_16px)]`.
Implement the TimelineRail using a vertical dashed border and glowing absolute positioned dots that connect down the page.
For the 6-accent engagement colors, define them as a map and apply them dynamically via inline styles for borders/shadows.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, graph nodes, and interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
